name: Sunbeam, Lesser
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid 3, shaman 3

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

This ability functions as sunbeam except it creates one beam per four caster levels (maximum of 5 beams at 20th level). The beam dazzles and deals 2d6 points of damage. The damage is doubled against creatures harmed by sunlight and a successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates the dazzled effect. The damage to undead is capped at 5d6 instead of 20d6.
